PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.S1_BODY: Finanzas (finanzasbr.com) is an application operated by the Finanzas team. This policy explains what data we collect, why, and how we protect it.
PRIVACY.S2_BODY: We collect only what is needed for the service to work:
PRIVACY.S2_LI1_BODY: your name, email and password (stored as a hash, never in plain text).
PRIVACY.S2_LI2_BODY: transactions, debts, installments, savings accounts and categories you enter yourself.
PRIVACY.S2_LI3_BODY: language, preferred currency and light/dark mode.
PRIVACY.S2_LI4_BODY: browser type and date of last access, used for security and support.
PRIVACY.S3_BODY: To authenticate you, show you your own information, send transactional emails (email verification, password recovery) and improve the service. We do not use your financial data for advertising nor share it with third parties for commercial purposes.
PRIVACY.S4_BODY: Data is stored in managed PostgreSQL databases hosted by Supabase, whose servers are located outside Latin America (United States or European Union depending on the active plan). Transactional email is sent through SendGrid. By using the service you accept this international data transfer, performed with providers that comply with recognized security standards.
PRIVACY.S5_BODY: We use browser local storage (localStorage) to keep the session token, language and theme preferences. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
PRIVACY.S6_BODY: If you are in Brazil (General Data Protection Law — LGPD No. 13.709/2018) or in another Latin American country with data protection regulations, you have the right to:
PRIVACY.S6_LI1: Access the data we hold about you.
PRIVACY.S6_LI3: Request deletion of your account and associated data.
PRIVACY.S6_LI4: Export your data in a readable format (coming soon from the app).
PRIVACY.S6_LI5: Withdraw your consent or file a complaint with your data protection authority.
PRIVACY.S7_BODY: We keep your data while your account is active. If you close the account, we delete personal data within a reasonable period, except what we must retain by legal obligation.
PRIVACY.S8_BODY: If we update this policy, we will notify you by email or from the app. The last update date appears at the top of this document.
